justification: Identifies the defect as the exists()-returns-null contract mismatch, quotes lines 724-727 with 726/727 called out, cites the real log evidence (replyHeader -101 NONODE for /app/workers/w4242), names the NPE site at 132, and lists the four conditions including 'the target path does not exist -> zk.exists returns null' and the unguarded printNodeMeta call. Also correctly identifies processCmd's catch list (584-594) as the reason the NPE kills the shell, and contrasts get/setAcl/delete whose APIs throw the caught NoNodeException. Fix proposal matches the real fix's intent.
claimed_lines: ZooKeeperMain.java:724-727 (meta branch: stat = zk.exists(path, watch); printNodeMeta(stat))
ZooKeeperMain.java:582-594 processCmd catch chain (why the NPE is fatal)
claimed_branches: path does not exist -> server returns NONODE(-101) -> zk.exists(path, watch) returns null (line 726)
printNodeMeta(stat) invoked at 727 with stat == null, dereferenced at 132
NPE not matched by processCmd's catch clauses (IllegalArgumentException + KeeperException subtypes)
gt_lines: ZooKeeperMain.java:726  stat = zk.exists(path, watch)  (meta branch of processZKCmd)
ZooKeeperMain.java:727  printNodeMeta(stat)  -- null passed unchecked; the fix inserts the guard here
gt_branches: cmd.equals("meta") && args.length >= 2  (ZooKeeperMain.java:724) -- the only branch that sources its Stat from ZooKeeper.exists()

the ABSENT `stat == null` guard between 726 and 727: ZooKeeper.exists() returns null (converting the server's NONODE/-101) instead of throwing NoNodeException, so the failure path is cmd==meta AND zk.exists(path,watch)==null
